_note: Card scenes: the pool. One scene for every real card, grouped under the tag of the card it was written for, its first tag. `scenes` is keyed by scene id; `card` is a suggestion, not a binding, and any card may end up with any scene. Scenes with a `from` keep a round-2 subject word for word; the rest are new. `adversary`, `discord` and `unity` are no card tags and their cards have no frame yet, so those groups hold only the scenes in a batch. A draw is `preamble`, `emphasis`, `lighting`, `framing`, the subject, then the tag's `accent`: `preamble` mixes round 2's styles C and E, `emphasis` is what stops a draw reading as a photograph, `framing` keeps the subject inside the middle 76% the building window crops to. `batch` is the current draw list: scene id to the two real cards it is composited on, one program or event and one building, so each scene is seen in both art windows; for the groups with no frame they are the nearest fit by name. Earlier batches are in picks/scene_batch_<n>.json (batch 9: picks/art_d69.json, batch 10: picks/art_d83.json), whose row ids (art_d69, art_d83: option keys) are the scenes already drawn. A scene with `was` in place of `card` is drawn but suggested for no card: its card was retired, or (083) redesigned and drawn again in batch 5. A scene with both `card` and `was` was written for `was` and reused (110) on `card`. A scene with `for` was drawn as a candidate for that card (152) and is suggested for none; a pick moves it to `card`. A scene with `was` and `for` is an unused draw put up as a candidate (186).
preamble: Stylized painterly board-game illustration in textured gouache, simplified forms and clean brush shapes, visible paper grain, soft clear warm natural light, moderately saturated palette, a confident silhouette with crisp detail on the subject and loose backgrounds, near-future setting: clean modern machinery, clothes and buildings, never historical.
emphasis: A hand-painted illustration on a board-game box, never a photograph or a 3D render: matte opaque paint, broad visible brush shapes, few details, large simple masses grouped by color, dry brush texture and paper grain everywhere, no glossy reflections.
lighting: Mid-key lighting, even daylight or clear interior light, never night-dark or blown-out; the scene's tag color as its accent; a strong silhouette that reads at card size. No text, logos, UI, or close-up faces.
framing: Keep the whole subject inside the middle two-thirds of the image height: only plain floor, ceiling or sky in the top and bottom sixths, nothing important there.

forecast_sand_table.subject: Analysts around a sand-table model of a coastline, small branching paths of light fanning out from each town.

red_team_at_whiteboard.subject: A team in red lanyards circling a boxed AI terminal in a test chamber, ticking through a long paper checklist.

grant_check_racks.subject: A university and a small lab's crews wheeling one rack of donated compute through a campus quad on a trolley.

exabyte_vault_mountain.subject: A vault cut into a mountainside, its enormous door open on endless illuminated aisles of storage.

model_campus.subject: A vast campus of low data halls and cooling ponds on a plain, one gleaming central spire, small buildings for scale.

observatory_array.subject: A line of telescope satellites spread in formation above Earth, their mirrors all turned the same way.

adversarial_sweep_scanners.subject: Rows of scanning arms sweeping a fan of blue light across a hall of models on plinths, flagging one with a marker.

data_license_handover.subject: A loading dock where crates of labeled data drives are checked against a contract by a lawyer and a courier.

weights_in_the_commons.subject: Great brass balance weights being handed down from a truck to a queuing crowd on a university green.

machine_rebuilding_itself.subject: A tall robot in a workshop carefully rebuilding its own arm, an older discarded version of itself on a bench beside it.

forensic_records_room.subject: Forensic investigators in white suits sweeping a captured city hall's records room, unplugging purple-glowing servers and boxing them as evidence.

shaker_rig_test.subject: Engineers stress-testing a server cabinet on a shaking rig in a test hall, a shield-shaped frame clamped around it as sparks bounce harmlessly off.

dish_fed_archive.subject: A long hall of humming storage cabinets fed by cables from antenna dishes outside the windows, an archivist holding up a printed chart to warn the room.

vault_drives_to_market.subject: A vast vault of glowing storage drawers cut into a mountainside, a forklift hauling crates of drives out to a buyer's waiting truck.

royalties_from_inventions.subject: A sunlit university workshop of small working inventions on display plinths, a thin ribbon of gold coins trickling from each one into a shared brass tray that a smiling researcher is emptying into a satchel.

moonshot_rocket_lawn.subject: A tall gleaming research rocket on a launch pad at the edge of a university research park, a pale moon in the daytime sky above it, scientists in shirtsleeves wheeling crates of glowing sky-blue research cubes to its base.

frontier_lab_opening.subject: A brand-new frontier research lab of glass and white steel opening on a hilltop campus, scientists in lab coats carrying the first crates of glowing sky-blue research cubes through its tall doors while a founder holds up a blank rolled charter to a small cheering crowd; no flags or emblems.

open_source_march.subject: A cheerful crowd of coders, students and engineers marching down a sunny avenue carrying laptops and plain sky-blue banners, a dark-suited adversary agent at the curb dropping a cold-blue badge to join them; no flags, logos, emblems or text.

double_agents_meet.subject: Two figures in raincoats swapping identical briefcases on a bench in a leafy city park under a bright overcast midday sky, a city skyline behind, one briefcase showing a faint cold-blue glow at its seam; figures at mid distance; no flags, logos, emblems or text.

kettle_cordon.subject: A ring of riot shields with coral-red trim closing around a sunlit city plaza seen from above, a small cluster of faceless gray machine troops and dark-suited agents herded into its center; no flags, logos, emblems or text.

surgical_strike_team.subject: A small tactical team in coral-trimmed gear stepping out of a landed helicopter onto a rooftop in bright daylight, one red smoke flare marking a single cold-blue adversary machine core among ordinary rooftop units, figures seen from behind; no flags, logos, emblems or text.

point_defense_turret.subject: A compact automated gun turret on a factory roof, its barrels tracking a small drone in the sky.

sentinel_watch_post.subject: A lone watchtower with a small solar array on a high ridge, one sentry looking out over the valley below.

shelter_blast_doors.subject: Families filing down into a public shelter past heavy open blast doors, a warden waving them on under a siren pole.

strike_team_rooftop.subject: A four-person strike team fast-roping from a helicopter onto a rooftop, dust blowing, figures seen from behind.

field_station_tent.subject: A discreet field station in a desert: a tent, radio mast and two parked trucks, an operative studying a map.

bunker_in_the_hillside.subject: A concrete bunker entrance set into a grassy hillside, thick steel doors, ventilation stacks and an access road.

interceptor_launchers.subject: A battery of missile launchers angled up on a plateau, one interceptor rising on a clean white trail.

kill_team_lineup.subject: Black-clad operators in a ready room gearing up at open lockers, seen from behind, a blank roster board on the wall.

safehouse_stairs.subject: An ordinary apartment block with a hidden back stair, a handler ushering a small family through a false wall.

contractor_glass_hq.subject: A sleek private security headquarters behind a fence, armored SUVs lined up neatly at its entrance.

drone_wing_launch.subject: A flight of small quadcopter sentries lifting off in formation from racks on the roof of a truck.

door_breach.subject: An armored squad stacked at a steel door in a concrete corridor, the door bursting inward in a puff of dust.

hardpoint_gates.subject: A fortified checkpoint with barriers dropping, spike strips rolled out, and guards taking up posts behind concrete.

bounty_noticeboard.subject: A weathered noticeboard outside a frontier outpost, faceless silhouette posters and a hunter pinning up a new one.

expulsion_at_airport.subject: A foreign delegation marched across an airport apron to a waiting plane, suitcases in hand, guards alongside.

countermeasure_flares.subject: A hardened server vault with automatic shutters slamming and a cloud of decoy flares bursting along a corridor.

shoulder_to_shoulder_shields.subject: Two nations' soldiers manning one sandbag wall together, two different flags planted at either end.

peacekeeper_trucks.subject: Fresh peacekeepers climbing down from trucks at a dusty base as the outgoing unit climbs up to leave.

recruits_on_the_course.subject: New recruits scrambling over a training obstacle course in clear daylight, an instructor watching with a stopwatch.

shared_intel_folders.subject: Analysts from several agencies around a table, sliding marked folders and photographs between them.

forecast_wall.subject: A machine of turning brass cylinders printing long paper strips of warnings, an analyst drawing them across a map.

triage_ops_table.subject: An operations room's huge map table, officers pushing a few markers forward and sweeping others aside.

aegis_dome.subject: A shimmering dome of hexagonal light raised over a whole city, emitter towers ringing its edge.

directorate_tower.subject: A windowless gray monolith of an agency headquarters rising above its car park, tiny figures streaming to its doors.

ledger_in_the_vault.subject: A single huge bound ledger on a lectern in a locked underground archive, a gloved hand turning its page.

orbital_rods_falling.subject: Thin bright streaks of orbital rods falling onto a distant fortified ridge, seen from far off across a plain.

sealed_hex_of_barricades.subject: A whole district ringed by giant concrete barriers and containment trucks, a crew closing the last gap.

cordon_of_soldiers.subject: A line of soldiers and armored vehicles strung across a wide boulevard, citizens held back behind tape.

mandate_on_the_desk.subject: A signed order lying on a war-room table beside a phone, a general's hand reaching for the receiver, jets lined up beyond the window.

ring_around_the_camp.subject: Armored vehicles forming a protective ring around a field camp, soldiers raising barriers while a hostile drone tumbles out of the sky overhead.

garrison_sand_table.subject: A fortified command post on a hilltop, officers around a sand-table model of the valley below, a radio mast and sandbagged walls behind them.

peacekeepers_through_the_gate.subject: Peacekeepers in light vehicles rolling through a freed city gate, residents stepping out to greet them, the occupier's barricades shoved aside.

sentinel_hill_base.subject: A wide hilltop base with a watchtower at each corner, radar dishes turning on its roof and patrol vehicles parked in neat rows below.

shelter_drill_marshal.subject: Office staff in a calm practiced drill, filing into a shelter while a siren tower turns on the roof and a marshal in an orange vest waves them through.

dome_emitter_crews.subject: Engineers bolting armor plates onto a ring of emitter towers around a city while a pale hexagonal dome of light flickers on above them, a falling missile glancing off it.

budget_before_the_dais.subject: A legislative committee room, members at a curved wooden dais raising their hands to approve, crates of military equipment and a model jet set out on the floor before them.

depot_rows_to_horizon.subject: A vast military depot yard with rows of new armored vehicles stretching to the horizon, an officer and a budget clerk walking the nearest row with a thick bound plan.

act_on_the_capitol_steps.subject: A capitol's broad steps where officials hold up a freshly signed act, guards, emergency crews and power engineers in plain unmarked uniforms, no emblems or crosses, lined up together in the plaza below.

raid_on_the_tower_lobby.subject: A security team in coral-trimmed tactical gear sweeping through the glass doors of a sleek corporate headquarters lobby in daylight, startled suited figures with raised hands, papers drifting off a reception desk.

checkpoint_chain_road.subject: A road winding over green hills with a small checkpoint on each rise, each a booth and a striped barrier with two guards checking a car, the chain of checkpoints running away to the horizon.

strike_on_the_rogue_hub.subject: A security team in coral-trimmed tactical gear storming a hijacked rooftop server hub in daylight, one pulling the thick cables from a glowing cold-blue machine core while others lead a line of dark-suited adversary envoys away, figures seen from behind; no flags or emblems.

double_agent_handoff.subject: Inside a sleek gray machine-run operations office with tall daylight windows, a dark-suited agent at a terminal passing a slim data drive behind their back to a courier in coral-trimmed overalls disguised as a cleaner, the other agents at their desks unaware; figures at mid distance; no flags, logos, emblems or text.

double_agents_cafe.subject: A busy sidewalk café in daylight, two people at neighboring tables sitting back to back behind open blank newspapers, one sliding a small envelope under the table to the other, a gray adversary patrol drone hovering unaware overhead; figures at mid distance; no flags, logos, emblems or text.

kettle_trucks_close_in.subject: Seen from a rooftop in daylight, coral-red armored trucks blocking every street into a city square, security crews in coral-trimmed gear pushing a cornered column of faceless gray machine troops into its middle; no flags, logos, emblems or text.

surgical_strike_beam.subject: A single thin coral-red beam from a small high drone striking one cold-blue adversary relay mast among a cluster of ordinary antennas on a sunny hilltop, everything around it untouched; no flags, logos, emblems or text.

marching_columns.subject: Faceless ranks of identical machine troops massing on a military base's parade ground, great war drums beating on a gantry above them.

dark_districts.subject: A city where whole districts have gone dark against a daytime storm sky, one hospital still lit. It is plainly daytime: a mid-gray sky with pale breaks in the cloud, the dark districts mid-toned and readable, not black.

breach_in_the_wall.subject: A city's sea wall broken open, angular gray landing craft pushing through the gap toward a panicked harbor.

blight_across_town.subject: A spreading stain of gray metal fungus creeping street by street through a pretty hill town, blocks already swallowed.

coins_in_the_jar.subject: A long folding table at a village fair, a queue of neighbors dropping coins into big glass jars for a shared cause.

volunteers_with_shovels.subject: A crowd of volunteers in matching armbands passing sandbags hand to hand down a street to shore up a riverbank.
